newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Sartid steel works produces 81,000T in June-agency.
newsitem.headline: Sartid steel works produces 81,000T in June-agency.

text.p: The steel works of the Smederevo iron and steel complex Sartid produced 81,352 tonnes of steel in June, a record since it resumed production in March 1996, state news agency Tanjug reported on Thursday.
Production in Sartid complex restarted in March 1996 after a virtual standstill of almost four years due to international war-related sanctions imposed on Yugoslavia in May 1992.
"This is the third time that the 750 steel mill workers have produced over 80,000 tonnes of steel in a month since the lifting of sanctions," said manager of the works Zoran Slovic.
The steel mill produced 420,000 tonnes of steel in the first six months of 1997.
If the production continues at this rate the works could produce 900,000 tonnes of steel by end of year, the report said.
